text:
Ava: Quick sync — OKR/Q3 runtime prioritization. We need to pick the top runtime initiatives for the roadmap: adaptive KV fallback for tail reduction, quantization profiles for small models, and a kernel-fusion spike. Propose we score by customer-visible SLO delta x implementation effort. Thoughts?

Ravi: +1 on scoring by p99 reduction and cost impact. KV adaptive fallback seems highest ROI for short-chat workloads where cache misses blow up the tail.

Samir: Data note — embedding pipelines aren't as sensitive to KV, but several customers saw p99 spikes when kv_miss_rate > 40%. Could be a common tipping point.

Jia: I'll pull telemetry today. Query: `SELECT customer_id, kv_miss_rate, p50, p95, p99 FROM runtime_calls WHERE model_family = 'chat' AND window = '7d'` — will share results here.

Maya: Agree on KV. Two concerns: 1) routing complexity (ensuring consistent routing for cache warm paths) and 2) correctness for streamed responses when fallback kicks in. Launch criteria proposal: >=20% p99 improvement for affected customers, median change <= +5%, no quality regressions above threshold.

perf-bot: queued telemetry job id 78322; estimated time 8m.

Ava: Also need to decide staffing tradeoff: 2 engineers for 6 sprints (faster) vs 1 for 12 sprints (cheaper). Which gets us shipping before Q3 OKR milestone?

Ravi: Two engineers to front-load KV fallback + rollout hooks. That lets us run an A/B canary across dedicated + hosted and validate p99 improvements.

Samir: Kernel work is longer runway — recommend a research spike this quarter (2 sprint spike) and defer large refactors until after KV and quant deliverables.

Jia: For quantization, propose canary on dedicated contexts: try 4-bit for Llama-2-7b with gold eval set; auto-fallback to fp16 on quality regressions. Need to define per-model thresholds.

Devon: Who owns the eval prompts for quant regression testing? We need per-customer prompt coverage for tiered rollback triggers.

Maya: Solutions engineering can provide top-10 prompt suites for our top 8 tier-1 customers — will share by Thu.

Ravi: Draft config for adaptive fallback (brainstorm):
```json
{"fallback_policy": "kv_first_then_model", "kv_miss_threshold": 0.4, "max_parallel_fetch": 8, "canary_percent": 5}
```

Ava: Good. Action items (owners + deadlines):
1) Jia — telemetry and p99 by customer EOD (owner: Jia).
2) Ravi — design doc for fallback + rollout APIs by Wed COB (owner: Ravi).
3) Samir — kernel research spike plan & dependencies by next Mon (owner: Samir).
4) Maya — customer prompt sets for quant evaluation by Thu (owner: Maya).
5) Devon — propose per-customer rollback thresholds and monitoring hooks by Fri (owner: Devon).

Ava: Launch criteria (draft): p99 improvement >= 20% for customers with kv_miss_rate >= 40%, median latency increase <= 5%, quality regressions 0 for contracted eval prompts, automated rollback trigger if failure rate > 2% or customer p99 degrades > 10%.

Ravi: ack — will include safety docs and metrics dashboard tiles (cost and latency).

Jia: ack — uploading telemetry CSV shortly.

Samir: ack — starting spike tomorrow.

Maya: ack — will coordinate with SE.

Devon: ack.

Ava: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Fri 11am to review telemetry and the draft design doc. :thumbsup:
